original_test_intent: Verify the full platform sustains concurrent eight-path network, storage, GPU and memory stress for 12 hours at 0C and +5% 5V/3.3V rails, with approved network throughput and no platform/data faults.
original_method: Freeze eight NIC/peer/IP paths, GPU/DIMM topology and immutable safe FIO targets; define synchronized workload profiles/load floors and per-path 80% baseline; control humidity/dew point, cold-soak and measured +5% rails; run all workloads for an exact 12-hour overlap with per-domain throughput, integrity, XID/ECC/AER/RAS, power/thermal and heartbeat evidence; stop on limits, clean up, warm safely and restore nominal state.
manual_activity: Operators configure peers/safe storage, control dry cold chamber/high rails, supervise concurrency and restore the lab.
safety_requirements: Never infer storage targets or run unapproved writes
Keep management isolated and OOB available
Abort on data error, XID/ECC/AER/RAS, link, thermal/power or heartbeat fault
Warm above dew point before chamber opening
agent_execution_scope: May validate identities/configs and analyze supplied concurrent evidence
Must not select targets, control chamber/rails or determine verdict
engineer_actions: Approve topology, workload matrix, baseline and cold profile
Review per-domain evidence and determine verdict

command_applicability.original_deepseek_command_fit: Correct manual boundary; generic full load lacks safe targets and synchronized per-domain commands.
command_applicability.command_recommendation: Run only approved SST/FIO/GPU/memory profiles against mapped endpoints/targets after dry cold/high-rail stability.
command_applicability.original_parameters_and_time_preserved: Eight network paths, FIO/GPU/DIMM concurrency, 12 hours, 0C, +5% rails and >80% network criterion are retained.

modernized_recommendation.recommended_method: Use a signed run manifest binding every workload interval and target to common dew-point/chamber/rail and health telemetry.
modernized_recommendation.difference_from_original_method: Adds immutable identities, safe storage, exact concurrency, interpretable network baseline, condensation controls and recovery.
modernized_recommendation.coverage_difference: Separate or staggered runs cannot reproduce shared power, cooling, PCIe, memory and I/O contention.
modernized_recommendation.risks_limitations: Aggregate throughput may hide one weak NIC, while a completed job may conceal corrected errors, storage resets or severe throttling.

project_override_considerations: Owner defines per-path versus aggregate 80%, storage destructiveness, concurrency overlap, corrected-error tolerance and cold stabilization.
expected_evidence: GPU XID/load and memory ECC/coverage plus power/thermal/RAS
Overlap, cleanup, safe warm-up and nominal post-health

review_improvement: Makes full cold/high-rail loading depend on traceable concurrent per-domain coverage and safe target handling.
independent_technical_reasoning: Concurrency is the central coverage because all workloads compete for PCIe, memory bandwidth, power and cooling. At cold/high-rail margin, one domain may reset or throttle while aggregate load continues, so per-path and per-target evidence synchronized to the overlap is required.
